Planning.title: Plan a week that fits
Planning.description: Give each task its place. See busy days before you commit, and leave a little room to breathe.
Planning.estimatesHint: Time estimates are a starting point, not a pace to keep. Adjust each task to fit your reading and study rhythm. Totals include completed work. Adhkar checkboxes are separate from planned minutes.
Planning.moveHint: Choose a day for each task and set the time you have available.
Planning.balanced: Distribution previewed. Review your week before committing.
Planning.scrollHint: Scroll or swipe to explore your week.
Planning.openDay: Room for a little more — or a day to rest.
Planning.dailyRoutine: Part of your daily reading routine
Planning.wirdForecast: Expected portion · updates with your reading progress
Planning.inboxHint: Give these tasks a day when you are ready. Past circle deadlines cannot be moved.
Planning.empty: A little space to plan ahead
Planning.emptyHint: Your scheduled portions and practice tasks will appear here. Future automatic batches appear once they are generated. You can set daily budgets now.
Planning.rulesHint: Automatic portions stay in order and within their scheduled week. One-off moves do not change your usual study days. Missed portions follow the existing carry-forward rules. Circle deadlines remain unchanged. Plan dates follow each plan’s time zone.
Planning.overloadHint: {count, plural, one {# day exceeds your time budget. Move a task or adjust your available time before committing.} other {# days exceed your time budget. Move tasks or adjust your available time before committing.}}
Planning.acknowledge: I have reviewed the overloaded days and want to keep this plan.

errors.stale: Your tasks or progress changed. Reload the current plan before saving.
errors.invalid: Check your task dates and time estimates.
errors.locked: Completed or fixed tasks cannot be moved.
errors.date: Choose a remaining day in this week, on or before the circle deadline.
errors.order: Keep memorization and revision portions in order, with one daily portion of each kind per day.
errors.overload: Review and acknowledge the overloaded days before committing.
errors.failed: We could not save your week. Your draft is still here. Please try again.
